translations.idiomatic: " Provincial ministers reported, "When recommendation and investigation disagree, remove the official from a post in a non-overlapping Punishments Bureau jurisdiction and investigate again; if results match, appoint under the regulations; if not, return him to his original seniority.

sentences.zh: 」時有議「凡當舉人之官，歲限以數，減資注受者。

translations.literal: " At that time there was discussion: "For all officials who should recommend men, annual limits by number, with reduced seniority for draft appointment and acceptance.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time some proposed annual quotas for recommending officials, with reduced seniority for those who drafted appointments.

sentences.zh: 」是日，省臣並奏，以謂如此恐滋久長求請僥倖之弊。

translations.literal: " That day provincial ministers all memorialized, saying that thus they feared breeding the long-term abuse of requests and lucky chances.
translations.idiomatic: " That day provincial ministers memorialized that such a rule would breed long-term favor-seeking and opportunism.

sentences.zh: 遂擬：「被舉官如體察相同，隨常升用，不如所舉者元舉官約量降除。

translations.literal: They then drafted: "If the recommended official's investigation matches, promote in the regular way; if not as recommended, the original recommender is approximately demoted or dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: They drafted a rule: if investigation confirmed the recommendation, promote normally; if not, demote the original recommender as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 如自囑求舉，或因勢要及為人請囑而舉之者，各追一官，受賄者以枉法論，體察官亦同此。

translations.literal: If self-requesting recommendation, or because of powerful connections and recommending at others' request, each strip one rank; those accepting bribes are judged as bending the law; investigating officials are treated the same.
translations.idiomatic: Self-solicited recommendations, recommendations through powerful connections, or recommendations at others' request each cost one rank; bribe-takers were prosecuted for bending the law, and investigating officials faced the same penalties.

sentences.zh: 歲舉不限數，不舉不坐罪，但不如所舉則有降罰，如此則必不敢濫舉，而實材可得。

translations.literal: Annual recommendations unlimited in number; not recommending incurs no punishment; but if not as recommended there is demotion penalty—thus they will surely not dare recommend recklessly, and real talent can be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Annual recommendations were unlimited and failure to recommend unpunished, but false recommendations brought demotion—so officials would not recommend recklessly and real talent could be found.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「是可止作條理，施行一二年，當別思其法。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "This may simply be made into regulations, implemented one or two years, and then another method should be considered.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Make this into regulations for a year or two, then reconsider the method.

sentences.zh: 」承安四年，以按察司不兼採訪，遂罷平倒別路除授之制。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year of Cheng'an, because surveillance commissions did not also conduct investigation, the system of balanced transfer and appointment in other circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " In Cheng'an 4 (1199), because surveillance commissions no longer also conducted investigations, the system of balanced transfers and appointments across circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 泰和元年，定制，自第一等闕外，第二等闕滿，合注縣令者升上令，少一任與中令，少二任與下令，少三任以上者與錄事軍防判，仍減一資，注令。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taihe, a standing rule was fixed: except first-grade vacancies, when second-grade vacancies were full, those qualifying for county magistrate rose to upper magistrate; one term short received middle magistrate; two terms short lower magistrate; three terms or more short received registrar or military defense judge, still reduced one seniority grade, nominated as magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 1 (1201) a rule fixed that beyond first-grade vacancies, when second-grade vacancies were full, those qualifying for county magistrate became upper magistrate; one term short meant middle magistrate; two terms short lower magistrate; three or more terms short meant registrar or military defense judge, with one seniority grade deducted, nominated as magistrate.

sentences.zh: 少五任以上者注丞簿。

translations.literal: Five terms or more short were nominated as deputy or registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Those five or more terms short were nominated as deputy or registrar.

sentences.zh: 第三等任滿，合注縣令者升中令，少一任與下令，少二任以上者與錄事防判，亦減一資，注令。

translations.literal: Third grade on term completion, those qualifying for county magistrate rose to middle magistrate; one term short received lower magistrate; two terms or more short received registrar or defense judge, also reduced one seniority grade, nominated as magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On third-grade term completion, those qualifying for county magistrate became middle magistrate; one term short meant lower magistrate; two or more terms short meant registrar or defense judge, with one seniority grade deducted, nominated as magistrate.

sentences.zh: 少四任以上者並注丞簿。

translations.literal: Four terms or more short were all nominated as deputy or registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Those four or more terms short were all nominated as deputy or registrar.

sentences.zh: 已入縣令者，秩滿日與上令，仍依各等資考內通減兩任呈省。

translations.literal: Those already entered as county magistrates, on rank completion day received upper magistrate, still following each grade's seniority and reviews with two terms comprehensively reduced and submitted to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Incumbent county magistrates received upper magistrate on rank completion, with two terms deducted within each seniority grade and reported to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 已任七品、六品者減一資注授，經保充縣令，明問相同，依資考不待滿升除，見隨朝者考滿升注，既升除後將來覆察公正廉能者不降。

translations.literal: Those already serving seventh and sixth rank had one seniority grade reduced for draft appointment; through guarantee filling county magistrate, open inquiry matching, following seniority and reviews without waiting for completion for promotion or dismissal; capital-attached on review completion received promoted draft nomination; after promotion or dismissal, future re-investigation of fair, upright, honest, and capable men was not demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Incumbent seventh- and sixth-rank officials received appointments with one seniority grade deducted; those guaranteed as county magistrates, if open inquiry confirmed, were promoted by seniority without waiting for term completion; capital officials were promoted on review completion; after promotion, those later found fair and capable were not demoted.

sentences.zh: 宣宗南遷，嘗以御史巡察。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong moved south, censors were once sent on inspection tours.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong moved south, censors were sent on inspection tours.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，以縣官或非材，監察御史一過不能備知，遂令每歲兩遣監察御史巡察，仍別選官巡訪，以行黜陟之政。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding, because county officials might not be the right material, censorial investigators in one pass could not fully know, so each year two dispatches of censorial investigators were ordered on inspection tours, and separately selected officials sent on circuit visits, to carry out the policy of demotion and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding 1 (1217), because county officials might be unqualified, one censorial pass could not reveal everything; two censorial inspection tours were ordered each year, with separately selected officials on circuit visits, to carry out promotions and demotions.

sentences.zh: 哀宗正大元年，設司農司，自卿而下迭出巡察吏治臧否，以升黜之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengda under Emperor Aizong, the Directorate of Agriculture was established; from the director downward they rotated out on inspection tours of officials' governance, good and bad, for promotion and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengda 1 (1224) under Emperor Aizong, the Directorate of Agriculture was established; from the director down its officials rotated on inspection tours to assess officials and promote or demote them.

sentences.zh: 舉薦。

translations.literal: Recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: Recommendation.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，詔隨朝六品、外路五品以上官，各舉廉能官一員。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading, an edict [ordered that] capital-attached sixth rank and outer-circuit fifth rank and above officials each recommend one honest and capable official.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 2 (1162) capital sixth-rank and outer-circuit fifth-rank officials and above were each ordered to recommend one honest and capable official.

sentences.zh: 三年，定制，若察得所舉相同者，即議旌除。

translations.literal: In the third year, a standing rule was fixed: if investigation found the recommendation matched, then discuss commendation and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year a rule fixed that when investigation confirmed a recommendation, commendation and appointment were discussed.

sentences.zh: 若聲跡穢濫，所舉官約量降罰。

translations.literal: If reputation and conduct are foul and abusive, the recommending official receives approximate demotion and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: If a nominee's reputation and conduct proved corrupt or abusive, the recommending official was appropriately demoted and punished.

sentences.zh: 九年，上曰：「朕思得忠廉之臣，與之共治，故嘗命五品以上各舉所知，於今數年矣！

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Emperor said: "I wish to obtain loyal and incorrupt officials to govern together with me; therefore I once ordered those of the fifth rank and above each to recommend those they know—this has now been several years!"
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Emperor said: "I want loyal and honest officials to help me govern; I once ordered fifth-rank officials and above to recommend people they knew—and years have passed!"

sentences.zh: 以天下之大，豈無其人？

translations.literal: With the empire so vast, how could there be no such persons?
translations.idiomatic: In an empire this vast, surely such people exist?

sentences.zh: 由在上者知而不舉也。

translations.literal: It is because those above know them but do not recommend.
translations.idiomatic: The fault lies with those above who know good candidates but fail to recommend them.

sentences.zh: 」參知政事魏子平奏曰：「可令當舉官者，每任須舉一人，視其當否以為旌賞。

translations.literal: Assistant Administrator Wei Ziping memorialized: "Those who should recommend could be ordered each term of office to recommend one person, and whether the recommendation was fitting could serve as the basis for commendation and reward."
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Administrator Wei Ziping proposed that officials obliged to recommend must nominate one person per term, with commendation or reward depending on whether the choice proved sound.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「一任舉一人，則人材或難，恐涉於濫。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "One recommendation per term of office would make talent scarce and risk excess and abuse."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "Requiring one recommendation per term would strain the supply of talent and invite indiscriminate nominations."

sentences.zh: 又少有所犯則罪舉者，故人益畏而不敢舉。

translations.literal: Moreover, when nominees commit even minor offenses the recommender is punished, so people grow ever more fearful and dare not recommend.
translations.idiomatic: Further, when nominees commit even minor offenses the recommender is punished, so officials grow afraid and stop recommending.

sentences.zh: 宋國被舉之官有犯罪者，所舉官雖宰執亦不免降黜，若有能名，則被遷賞。

translations.literal: In the Song state, when recommended officials committed crimes, even the recommending chief ministers were not exempt from demotion; if there was a reputation for ability, then one received transfer and reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song, when a recommended official committed a crime even the recommender—a chief minister—was demoted; only those with a proven record of good recommendations were promoted.

sentences.zh: 且人情始慕進，故多廉慎，既得任用，或失所守。

translations.literal: Moreover, human nature at first aspires to advancement, so many are incorrupt and cautious; once given appointment, some lose their integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, people are careful and honest when seeking advancement, but once appointed some fail to maintain their standards.

sentences.zh: 宰執自掌黜陟之權，豈可因所舉而置罪耶？

translations.literal: Chief ministers themselves hold the power of demotion and promotion—how could they be punished because of those they recommended?
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers control promotions and demotions themselves—how can they be punished for a nominee's misconduct?

sentences.zh: 」左丞相紇石列良弼曰：「已申前令，命舉之矣。

translations.literal: Left Grand Chancellor Heishilie Liangbi said: "The previous order has already been transmitted; they have been commanded to recommend."
translations.idiomatic: Left Grand Chancellor Heishilie Liangbi said: "We have already reissued the prior order commanding officials to recommend."

sentences.zh: 」十年，上曰：「舉人之法，若定三品官當舉幾人，是使小官皆諂媚於上也。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Emperor said: "In the law of recommending persons, if we fix how many persons third-rank officials must recommend, this makes petty officials all fawn upon their superiors."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Emperor said: "Fixing how many nominees each third-rank official must submit would only make junior officials flatter their superiors."

sentences.zh: 惟任滿詢察前政，則得人矣。

translations.literal: Only upon completion of term inquiring and inspecting the prior administration would one obtain the right people.
translations.idiomatic: What works is reviewing a predecessor's record at the end of one's term—that is how you find good people.

sentences.zh: 」十一年，上謂宰臣曰：「昨觀貼黃，五品以下官多闕，而難於得人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Emperor said to the chief ministers: "Yesterday I viewed the attached yellow memorial; offices below the fifth rank are largely vacant, yet suitable persons are hard to obtain."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he told his chief ministers: "Yesterday's memorial showed many vacancies below the fifth rank, yet good candidates are hard to find."

sentences.zh: 凡三品以上，朕則自知，五品以下，不能盡識，卿等曾無一言見舉者。

translations.literal: For all third rank and above, I myself know them; below the fifth rank I cannot fully recognize—yet you have not a single word of recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: I know everyone third rank and above myself; below the fifth rank I cannot know them all—yet not one of you has offered a recommendation.

sentences.zh: 國家之務，朕豈能獨盡哉！

translations.literal: The affairs of the state—how could I alone exhaust them!
translations.idiomatic: I cannot manage the state alone!

sentences.zh: 蓋嘗思之，欲畫久安之計，興百姓之利，而無良輔佐，雖有所行皆尋常事耳。

translations.literal: I have long reflected: I wish to draw up a plan for lasting peace and advance the people's benefit, yet without good assistants, though I act it is all ordinary business.
translations.idiomatic: I want lasting stability and prosperity for the people, but without capable helpers everything we do stays ordinary.

sentences.zh: 」十九年，時朝廷既取民所譽望之官而升遷之，後，上以隨路之民赴都舉請者，往往無廉能之實，多為所使而來沽名者，不須舉行。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, by then the court had taken officials praised by the people and promoted them; afterwards the Emperor, [finding that] people from each circuit who came to the capital to petition for recommendation often lacked honest and capable reality—many came as agents sent to trade on reputation—ordered that no action need be taken on such recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, after the court had already promoted officials praised by the populace, the Emperor found that petitioners from the circuits who came to the capital often lacked real integrity and ability—many were merely agents seeking fame—and such petitions were no longer to be acted upon.

sentences.zh: 章宗大定二十九年，上以選舉十事，命奉禦合魯諭尚書省定擬。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Zhangzong in the twenty-ninth year of Dading, the Emperor, on ten matters of selection and appointment, ordered Palace Attendant Helu to instruct the provincial office to draft regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 29 (1189), under Emperor Zhangzong, the Emperor set forth ten points on official selection and ordered Palace Attendant Helu to have the provincial office draft regulations.

sentences.zh: 其一曰：「舊格，進士、軍功最高，尚且初除丞簿，第五任縣令升正七品，兩任正七品升六品，三任六品升從五品，兩任從五升正五品，正五三任而後升刺史，計四十餘年始得至刺史也，其他資格出職者可知矣。

translations.literal: The first says: "Under old regulations, even those highest among jinshi and military merit still began with initial appointment as assistant magistrate or registrar; in the fifth term as county magistrate one rose to regular seventh rank, two terms at regular seventh to sixth rank, three terms at sixth to secondary fifth, two terms at secondary fifth to regular fifth, and three terms at regular fifth before rising to prefect—in all over forty years before reaching prefect; those of other qualifications and career backgrounds may be inferred."
translations.idiomatic: First: "Under the old rules, even top jinshi graduates and holders of military merit started as registrar or assistant magistrate; only after five terms as county magistrate could one reach regular seventh rank, and it took more than forty years to become a prefect. Other career paths were similarly slow."

sentences.zh: 拘於資格之滯，至於如此，其令提刑司採訪可用之才，減資考而用之，庶使可用者不至衰老。

translations.literal: Constrained by the stagnation of qualifications to such a point, let the Punishments Bureau seek out usable talent and use reduced seniority requirements in appointment, so that usable persons might not reach old age unused.
translations.idiomatic: Bound by rigid seniority rules, promotion took decades; the Punishments Bureau should seek out capable talent and appoint them with reduced seniority requirements so able people are not wasted by old age.

sentences.zh: 」省臣遂擬，凡三任升者減為兩任，於此資歷內，遇各品闕多，則于第二任未滿人內，選人材、苦辛可以超用者，及外路提刑司所採訪者，升擢之。

translations.literal: The provincial ministers then drafted: all promotions requiring three terms were reduced to two; within this seniority, when vacancies at each rank were many, from those in their second term not yet complete select those with talent and hard service who could be specially promoted, as well as those the outer-circuit Punishments Bureau had sought out, and elevate them.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial ministers proposed reducing three-term promotions to two terms; when vacancies were numerous, officials in their second incomplete term who showed talent and hardship, or those scouted by outer-circuit Punishments Bureaus, could be promoted ahead of schedule.

sentences.zh: 其二曰：「舊格，隨朝苦辛驗資考升除者，任滿回日一而複降之。

translations.literal: The second says: "Under old regulations, those capital-attached who had verified hard service in seniority for promotion, upon completion of term returning were demoted one rank in the cycle."
translations.idiomatic: Second: "Under the old rules, capital-attached officials who earned promotion through verified hardship were demoted one step when their term ended and they returned to the capital."

sentences.zh: 如正七滿回降除從七品，從五品回降為六品之類。

translations.literal: For example, upon completion at regular seventh rank returning, demoted and appointed at secondary seventh; returning from secondary fifth demoted to sixth rank, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: For example, upon completing a term at regular seventh rank one returned at secondary seventh; upon completing secondary fifth one returned at sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 今若其人果才能，可為免降。

translations.literal: Now if such a person truly has ability and talent, exemption from demotion may be granted.
translations.idiomatic: If the official is truly capable, the demotion may be waived.

sentences.zh: 」尚書吏部遂擬，今隨朝考滿，遷除外路五品以下職事，並應驗考次職滿有才能者，以本官任滿已前十五月以上、二十月以內，察訪保結呈省。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel Directorate then drafted: now when capital-attached complete examination and are transferred to outer-circuit posts below fifth rank, all who upon verification of the next term's completion have talent—within fifteen months or more to twenty months before completion of the present rank—shall be investigated, guaranteed, certified, and submitted to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel proposed that capital-attached officials completing their examinations and transferring to outer-circuit posts below fifth rank, if talented, could within fifteen to twenty months before term's end be investigated, certified by guarantors, and submitted to the provincial office to waive demotion.

sentences.zh: 其三曰：「隨路提刑所訪廉能之官，就令定其堪任職事，從宜遷注。」

translations.literal: The third says: "Officials of integrity and ability whom circuit Punishments Bureaus visit—thereupon order determination of posts they can bear, and transfer and register them as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: Third: "Honest and capable officials identified by circuit Punishments Bureaus should be assigned to suitable posts as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 其四曰：「從來宰相不得與求仕官相見，如此何由知天下人材優劣。

translations.literal: The fourth says: "From of old prime ministers have not been permitted to meet office-seekers—how by such means could one know the quality of talent throughout the realm?"
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: "Prime ministers have traditionally been barred from meeting office-seekers—under such rules how can they know who is qualified?"

sentences.zh: 其許相見，以訪才能。

translations.literal: Permit them to meet, to inquire into talent and ability.
translations.idiomatic: They should be permitted to meet candidates in order to assess talent.

sentences.zh: 」尚書刑部謂：「在制，求仕官不得於私第謁見達官，違者追一官降等奏除。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Justice Directorate said: "Under the statute, office-seekers must not visit eminent officials at private residences; violators have one rank stripped, are demoted a grade, and reported for dismissal."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice noted the existing rule that office-seekers must not call on high officials at private residences; violators lost a rank, were demoted, and reported for dismissal.

sentences.zh: 若有求請饋遺，則以奏聞，仍委御史糾察。

translations.literal: If there are requests and gift offerings, then report to the throne, and still assign censors to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Any solicitation or gifts were to be reported, with censors assigned to investigate.

sentences.zh: 」上遂命削此制。

translations.literal: The Emperor thereupon ordered this regulation abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered this regulation repealed.

sentences.zh: 其五曰：「舊時，臣下雖知親友有可用者，皆欲遠嫌而不引薦。

translations.literal: The fifth says: "In former times, though subordinates knew relatives and friends who were usable, all wished to keep distant from suspicion and did not refer and recommend."
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: "Officials who knew capable friends and relatives often avoided recommending them for fear of appearing partial."

sentences.zh: 古者舉賢不避親仇，如祁奚舉仇，仁傑舉子，崔祐甫除吏八百皆親故也。

translations.literal: In antiquity recommending the worthy did not avoid kin or enemies, as Qi Xi recommending his enemy, Renjie recommending his son, Cui Youfu appointing eight hundred officials all kin and associates.
translations.idiomatic: Antiquity knew no such scruple: Qi Xi recommended his enemy, Di Renjie recommended his son, and Cui Youfu appointed eight hundred relatives and associates.

sentences.zh: 其令五品以上官，各舉所知幾人，違者加以蔽賢之罪。

translations.literal: Let officials of the fifth rank and above each recommend several persons known to them; violators are subject to the crime of concealing the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Let each official fifth rank and above recommend those they know; failure to do so is the crime of concealing talent.

sentences.zh: 」吏部議，內外五品以上職事官，每歲保廉能官一人。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel discussed: inner and outer fifth-rank and above functional officials each year guarantee one honest and capable official.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel proposed that inner and outer functional officials fifth rank and above each year guarantee one honest and capable official.

sentences.zh: 外路五品，隨朝六品願舉者聽。

translations.literal: Outer-circuit fifth rank, capital-attached sixth rank—those who wish to recommend may do so.
translations.idiomatic: Outer-circuit fifth-rank and capital-attached sixth-rank officials might recommend if they chose.

sentences.zh: 若不如所舉者，各約量降罰。

translations.literal: If not as recommended, each receives approximate demotion and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: If nominees did not match their recommendation, the guarantor was appropriately demoted and punished.

sentences.zh: 今擬賢而不舉者，亦當約量降罰。

translations.literal: Now it is proposed that those who have worthy persons but do not recommend should also receive approximate demotion and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: It was also proposed that officials who failed to recommend worthy people they knew should be appropriately punished.

sentences.zh: 其六曰：「前代官到任之後，即舉可自代者，其令自今五品以上官，舉自代以備交承。

translations.literal: The sixth says: "In former dynasties, after an official took office he immediately recommended one who could replace himself; let it be ordered from now that officials fifth rank and above recommend self-replacements to prepare for turnover."
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: "Previous dynasties required new appointees to nominate a successor; from now on officials fifth rank and above should nominate replacements to ensure orderly succession."

sentences.zh: 」吏部按《唐會要》，建中元年赦文，文武常參官外，節度、觀察、防禦、軍使、刺史、赤令、畿令、並七品以上清官，大理司直評事，受命之三日，于四方館上表，讓一人以自代，外官則馳驛奏聞。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel consulted the Tang Huiyao, amnesty of the first year of Jianzhong: apart from regular civil and military officials at court, military commissioners, surveillance commissioners, defense commissioners, army commissioners, prefects, capital county magistrates, capital-district magistrates, all pure officials seventh rank and above, and directorate evaluators of the Court of Judicial Review—within three days of receiving appointment at the Four Directions Hostel submit a memorial yielding one person to replace oneself; outer officials report by dispatch post.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry cited the Tang Huiyao: under the Jianzhong amnesty, officials from military commissioners down to seventh-rank "pure" officials and judicial reviewers had three days after appointment to submit at the Four Directions Hostel a memorial nominating a replacement; outer officials reported by dispatch courier.

sentences.zh: 表付中書門下，每官闕即以所舉多者量授。

translations.literal: The memorial was delivered to the Secretariat and Chancellery; whenever an office fell vacant the most frequently recommended was approximately appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials went to the Secretariat; when a vacancy opened, the most frequently nominated candidate was appointed.

sentences.zh: 今擬內外官五品以上到任，須舉所知才行官一員以自代。

translations.literal: Now it is proposed that inner and outer officials fifth rank and above, upon taking office, must recommend one talented and capable official known to them as self-replacement.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed that all inner and outer officials fifth rank and above, upon taking office, must nominate one capable official they knew as their replacement.

sentences.zh: 太傅、丞相、平章謂：「自古人材難得，若令舉以自代，恐濫而不得實材。

translations.literal: The Grand Preceptor, Grand Chancellor, and Associate Administrators said: "From of old talent has been hard to obtain; if ordered to recommend to replace oneself, one fears excess and failure to obtain real talent."
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Preceptor, Grand Chancellor, and associate administrators objected: "Talent has always been scarce; requiring self-replacement nominations risks flooding the lists with unqualified names."

sentences.zh: 」參政謂：「自代非謂即令代其人也，止類姓名，取所舉多者約量授之爾，此蓋舜官相讓，《周官》推賢之遺意。

translations.literal: An associate administrator said: "Self-replacement does not mean immediately having that person replace one—it is merely listing names; take those most recommended and approximately appoint—that is all. This is the remnant intent of officials yielding to one another under Shun and recommending the worthy in the Zhou Offices."
translations.idiomatic: An associate administrator replied: "Self-replacement does not mean immediate succession—it means registering names so that the most frequently nominated can be appointed; this follows the ancient tradition of mutual recommendation from the Zhou Offices."

sentences.zh: 」上以參政所言與吏部同，從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, [finding that] the associate administrator's words matched the Ministry of Personnel, approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed with the associate administrator and the Ministry, and approved.

sentences.zh: 其七曰：「隨朝、外路長官，一任之內足知僚屬之能否，每任可令舉幾人。

translations.literal: The seventh says: "Capital-attached and outer-circuit chiefs, within one term of office fully know their subordinates' capacity; each term they could be ordered to recommend several persons."
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: "Capital-attached and outer-circuit chiefs know their subordinates' abilities within one term; each term they should recommend several."

sentences.zh: 」吏部擬，今內外五品以上職事官長，于僚屬內須舉才能官一人，數外舉者聽。

translations.literal: The Ministry drafted: now chiefs among inner and outer fifth-rank and above functional officials must from among subordinates recommend one talented official; recommending beyond the quota is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry proposed that chiefs among fifth-rank functional officials and above must recommend one talented subordinate, with additional nominations permitted.

sentences.zh: 其八曰：「人才隨色有之，監臨諸物料及草澤隱逸之士，不無人材，宜薦舉用之。

translations.literal: The eighth says: "Talent exists among every category; overseers of various material stores and reclusive scholars in the grasslands—talent is not lacking; they should be recommended and appointed."
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: "Talent appears in every walk of life—warehouse overseers, recluses in the countryside; such people should be recommended and employed."

sentences.zh: 」吏部擬，監臨諸物料內，以外路五品、隨朝六品以上，舉廉能者，直言所長，移文轉申省，差官察訪得實，隨材任使。

translations.literal: The Ministry drafted: among overseers of various material stores, let outer-circuit fifth rank and capital-attached sixth rank and above recommend the honest and capable, state their strengths directly, transfer documents and submit to the provincial office; dispatch officials to investigate, and if verified appoint according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry proposed that outer-circuit fifth-rank and capital-attached sixth-rank officials recommend honest, capable warehouse overseers, state their strengths, submit reports to the provincial office, and after investigation appoint them as their talents warranted.

sentences.zh: 草澤隱逸，當遍下司縣，以提刑司察訪呈省。

translations.literal: Reclusive scholars in the grasslands—orders should be sent down to all prefectures and counties; let the Punishments Bureau investigate and submit to the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: For reclusive scholars, orders should go to all counties for the Punishments Bureau to investigate and report to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 隨色人材，令內外五品以上職官薦之。

translations.literal: Talent of every category—order inner and outer fifth-rank and above functional officials to recommend them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials fifth rank and above inside and outside the capital should recommend talent from every category.

sentences.zh: 其九曰：「親軍出職，內有尤長武藝，勇敢過人者，其令內外官舉、提刑司察，如資考高者，可參注沿邊刺史、同知、縣令。

translations.literal: The ninth says: "Among those leaving service from the Imperial Guard, within are those exceptionally skilled in martial arts, surpassing others in bravery; let inner and outer officials recommend and the Punishments Bureau investigate; if seniority is high, they may be considered for registration as frontier prefect, vice-prefect, or county magistrate."
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: "Among veterans of the Imperial Guard are men of exceptional martial skill and bravery; inner and outer officials should recommend them and the Punishments Bureau investigate; those with sufficient seniority may be considered for frontier prefect, vice-prefect, or county magistrate."

sentences.zh: 」吏部擬，若依本格資歷，恐妨才能，若舉察得實者，依本格減一資歷擬注。

translations.literal: The Ministry drafted: if according to the original regulations' seniority, one fears hindering talent; if recommendation and investigation verify truth, draft registration with one rank of seniority reduced under the original regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry proposed that rigid seniority rules could block talent; verified recommendations could receive registration with one rank of seniority waived.

sentences.zh: 尚書省擬，依旨升品擬注。

translations.literal: The provincial office drafted: according to the imperial intent, draft registration with rank elevation.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial office proposed elevation in rank for verified candidates.

sentences.zh: 其十曰：「內外官所薦人材，即依所舉試之，委提刑司採訪虛實，若果能稱職，更加遷擢，如或碌碌，即送常調。

translations.literal: The tenth says: "Talent recommended by inner and outer officials—immediately test them according to the recommendation; commission the Punishments Bureau to investigate truth and falsity; if they truly fit their duties, further promote; if mediocre, send them to normal seniority progression."
translations.idiomatic: Tenth: "Recommended talent should be tested as proposed; the Punishments Bureau should verify credentials; the capable should be further promoted, the mediocre returned to ordinary career tracks."

sentences.zh: 古者進賢受上賞，進不肖有罰，其立定賞罰條格，庶使人不敢徇私也。

translations.literal: In antiquity advancing the worthy received highest reward, advancing the unworthy brought punishment; establish fixed reward and punishment regulations, so that people dare not act from private motive.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity recommending the worthy brought great rewards and recommending the unworthy brought punishment; fixed rules of reward and punishment would deter favoritism.

sentences.zh: 」省臣議，隨款各欲舉人，則一人內所舉不下五七人。

translations.literal: Provincial ministers discussed: under each item if each wished to recommend persons, then within one person the recommended would be no fewer than five or seven.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial ministers noted that under each item officials might nominate five to seven people each.

sentences.zh: 自古知人為難，人材亦自難得，限數多則猥避責罰、務苟簡，不副聖主求賢之意。

translations.literal: From antiquity knowing persons has been difficult, and talent is itself hard to obtain; when quotas are many, then perfunctorily avoiding responsibility and punishment, striving for the perfunctory, this does not match the sage ruler's intent to seek the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing people has always been difficult, and talent is scarce; high quotas would encourage perfunctory lists that defeat the purpose of seeking talent.

sentences.zh: 擬以前項各款，隨色能舉一人，即充歲舉之數。

translations.literal: It is proposed that under each of the preceding items, if able to recommend one person of that category, that suffices for the year's recommendation quota.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed that one successful nomination in any category would count toward the annual quota.

sentences.zh: 如此則不濫，而實材得矣。

translations.literal: Thus there would be no excess, and real talent would be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This would avoid indiscriminate nominations while securing real talent.

sentences.zh: 每歲貢人數，尚書省覆察相同，則置簿籍之，如有闕則當隨材奏擬。

translations.literal: Each year's number of persons presented—the provincial office re-investigates for agreement, then registers them in ledgers; if there are vacancies, then appropriately memorialize and draft according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial office would review and register annual nominations; vacancies would be filled with suitable candidates as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 宣宗興定元年，令隨朝七品、外路六品以上職事官，舉正七品以下職事官年未六十、不犯贓，堪任使者一人。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong, first year of Xingding, ordered capital-attached seventh rank and outer-circuit sixth rank and above functional officials to recommend one functional official of regular seventh rank and below, under sixty years, not guilty of corruption, who could bear assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding 1 (1217) under Emperor Xuanzong, capital-attached seventh-rank and outer-circuit sixth-rank officials were ordered to recommend one sub-seventh-rank official under sixty, free of corruption, and fit for assignment.

sentences.zh: 三年，定辟舉縣令制。

translations.literal: In the third year, the system of direct recommendation for county magistrates was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the system of direct recommendation for county magistrates was established.

sentences.zh: 稱職，則元舉官減一資歷。

translations.literal: If fitting the duties, then the original recommending official has one rank of seniority reduced.
translations.idiomatic: If the nominee performed well, the recommender gained one rank of seniority.

sentences.zh: 中平，約量升除。

translations.literal: If middling, approximately promoted or dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: If performance was middling, the recommender was promoted or demoted as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 不稱，罰俸一月。

translations.literal: If not fitting, one month's salary fined.
translations.idiomatic: If the nominee failed, the recommender was fined one month's salary.

sentences.zh: 犯免官，免所居官。

translations.literal: If guilty of an offense warranting dismissal from office, dismissed from the rank held.
translations.idiomatic: If the nominee committed an offense warranting dismissal, the recommender lost his current rank.

sentences.zh: 及官當私罪解任、杖罪、贓汙者，約量降除。

translations.literal: And for substitution for private crimes with dismissal from post, beating-punishment crimes, or corruption—the approximate demotion and dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Private offenses, corporal punishment, or corruption on the nominee's part brought appropriate demotion for the recommender.

sentences.zh: 汙贓至徒以上及除名者，一任不理資考。

translations.literal: Corruption reaching penal servitude and above and dismissal from the roster—for one term of office seniority is not credited.
translations.idiomatic: Corruption warranting penal servitude or expulsion from the roster meant the recommender's seniority went uncredited for one term.

sentences.zh: 三品以上舉縣令，稱職者約量升除，不稱奪俸一月。

translations.literal: Third rank and above recommending county magistrates—if fitting, approximately promote; if not, strip one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officials who recommended county magistrates were promoted if the nominee succeeded and fined one month's salary if not.

sentences.zh: 若被舉者犯免官等罪，奪俸兩月。

translations.literal: If the recommended person commits an offense such as dismissal from office, strip two months' salary.
translations.idiomatic: If the nominee committed an offense warranting dismissal, the recommender lost two months' salary.

sentences.zh: 贓汙至徒以上及除名者，奪俸三月，獄成，而會赦原者，亦原之。

translations.literal: Corruption to penal servitude and above and expulsion—strip three months' salary; when the case is closed, if coinciding with amnesty and pardon, pardon as well.
translations.idiomatic: Corruption warranting penal servitude or expulsion cost three months' salary, though amnesty could restore even that penalty once the case was closed.

sentences.zh: 五年，制辟舉縣令考平者，元舉者不得複舉，他人舉之者聽。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, it was regulated: for direct recommendation of county magistrates with middling evaluation, the original recommender may not recommend again; others recommending is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year a rule fixed that when a directly recommended county magistrate received a middling evaluation, the original recommender could not recommend again, though others might.

sentences.zh: 又舊制，保舉縣令秩滿之後，以六事論升降，三事以下減一資歷，四事減兩資歷，六事皆備則升職一等。

translations.literal: Also under the old system, after guaranteed-recommendation county magistrates completed their terms, promotion and demotion were judged by six criteria: three criteria or below reduced one rank of seniority; four criteria reduced two; all six fulfilled then promoted one grade of office.
translations.idiomatic: Under the older guarantee system, after a county magistrate's term six performance criteria determined the guarantor's reward: three or fewer met meant one seniority rank deducted, four meant two, all six meant promotion one grade.

sentences.zh: 既而御史張升卿言：「進士中下甲及第人、及監官至明威當入縣丞主簿，而三事以下減一資歷注下令，四事減注中令，令皆七品也，若複八品矣。

translations.literal: Subsequently Censor Zhang Shengqing said: "Jinshi of middle and lower first rank who passed, and supervisory officials reaching Mingwei who ought to enter as county assistant or registrar—with three criteria or below, one seniority rank reduced registers as lower county magistrate; four criteria reduced registers as middle county magistrate—the magistracies are all seventh rank; this would again make eighth rank."
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Shengqing objected: "Lower-ranked jinshi and supervisory officials destined for assistant magistrate or registrar would, under the guarantee rewards, be appointed as seventh-rank lower or middle county magistrate after seniority reductions—effectively demoting them to eighth rank."

sentences.zh: 輕重相戾，宜更定之。

translations.literal: Light and heavy contradict each other; it is appropriate to re-fix.
translations.idiomatic: The rewards and penalties were inconsistent and needed revision.

sentences.zh: 」遂定制，自今四事以下如前條，六事完者，進士中下甲及第、監官當入縣丞主簿人，減三資歷，注上令。

translations.literal: Thereupon a standing rule was fixed: from now four criteria and below as in the prior article; all six criteria complete—jinshi middle and lower first rank, supervisory officials who should enter as assistant magistrate or registrar—with three seniority ranks reduced, register as upper county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: A revised rule fixed that with four criteria or fewer the old penalties applied; with all six criteria met, lower jinshi and supervisory officials received three ranks of seniority reduction and appointment as upper county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 餘出身者亦同此。

translations.literal: Others by career background are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of other backgrounds were treated likewise.

sentences.zh: 任二十月以上，雖未秩滿，若以理去官，六事之跡已經覆察，論升如秩滿例。

translations.literal: Serving twenty months or more—though the term of rank is not complete, if leaving office for legitimate reason, once the six-criteria record has been re-investigated, promotion is judged as upon term completion.
translations.idiomatic: After twenty months' service, even if a magistrate left office before term's end for legitimate reasons, once the six criteria were verified the guarantor's reward followed the full-term rule.

sentences.zh: 五年，以舉官或私其親，或徇於請求，或謬於鑒裁而妄舉，數歲之間以濫去者九十餘人，乃罷辟舉縣令之制。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because recommending officials either favored their kin, or yielded to requests, or erred in judgment and recklessly recommended—in several years over ninety were removed for abuse—the system of direct recommendation for county magistrates was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, because recommenders favored relatives, accepted bribes, or misjudged candidates—more than ninety incompetents removed in a few years—the direct recommendation system for county magistrates was abolished.

sentences.zh: 至哀宗正大元年，乃立法，命監察御史、司農司官，先訪察隨朝七品、外路六品以上官，清慎明潔可為舉主者，然後移文使舉所知，仍以六事課殿最，而升黜舉主。

translations.literal: By Emperor Aizong's first year of Zhengda, a law was then made: censorial investigators and Directorate of Agriculture officials were first to investigate capital-attached seventh rank and outer-circuit sixth rank and above officials who were honest, cautious, clear, and pure and could serve as recommending masters; then transfer documents ordering them to recommend those they know; still using the six criteria to assess best and worst performance, and promote or demote the recommending master.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengda 1 (1224) under Emperor Aizong a new law required censorial investigators and Directorate of Agriculture officials first to identify honest capital-attached seventh-rank and outer-circuit sixth-rank officials fit to serve as recommenders, then authorize them to nominate candidates; the six performance criteria determined the recommender's reward or punishment.

sentences.zh: 故舉主既為之盡心，而被舉者亦為之盡力。

translations.literal: Therefore the recommending master already gave full devotion on this account, and the recommended also gave full effort on this account.
translations.idiomatic: Recommenders therefore did their utmost, and nominees likewise exerted themselves fully.

sentences.zh: 是時雖迫危亡，而縣令號為得人，由作法有足取雲。

translations.literal: At that time, though pressed toward peril and extinction, county magistrates were praised as obtaining the right persons—because the method had points worth taking.
translations.idiomatic: Though the dynasty was near collapse, county magistrates were said to be well chosen—a method with much to commend it.

sentences.zh: 功酬虧永

translations.literal: Merit compensation; perpetual fault.
translations.idiomatic: Merit Compensation and Perpetual Fault

sentences.zh: 功酬虧永之制。

translations.literal: The system of merit compensation and perpetual fault.
translations.idiomatic: The system of merit compensation and perpetual fault.

sentences.zh: 凡諸提點院務官，三十月遷一官，周歲為滿，止取無虧月日用之。

translations.literal: For all supervisors of bureau establishments, every thirty months one rank is advanced; a full year constitutes completion of term; only days without fault are counted for use.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors of bureau establishments advanced one rank every thirty months; a full year counted as a term, reckoned only by days without fault.

sentences.zh: 大定四年，定制，一任內虧一分以上降五人，二分以上降十人，三分以上降十五人，若有增羨則依此升遷，其升降不盡之數，于後任充折。

translations.literal: Dading fourth year, standing rule: within one term fault of one tenth or more demotes five persons; two tenths or more demotes ten; three tenths or more demotes fifteen; if there is surplus increase, promotion follows the same; numbers of promotion and demotion not exhausted are applied as offset in the succeeding term.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 4 (1164) a rule fixed that within one term a fault of one-tenth reduced standing by five places, two-tenths by ten, three-tenths by fifteen; surplus merit brought proportional promotion; unused adjustments carried forward to the next term.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，以舊制監當官並責決，而不顧廉恥之人，以謂已決即得赴調，不以刑罰為畏。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, because under the old system supervisory warehouse officials were all subjected to beating, persons who heed not integrity and shame took it that once beaten they could report for assignment, not fearing punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, because warehouse supervisors were routinely beaten, the shameless treated a beating as sufficient to qualify for reassignment and feared no further punishment.

sentences.zh: 擬自今，若虧永及一酬以上，依格追官殿一年外，虧永不及酬者，亦殿一年。

translations.literal: It is proposed from now: if perpetual fault reaches one compensation unit or more, besides stripping rank and barring for one year according to regulations, if perpetual fault does not reach one compensation unit, still bar for one year.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed that henceforth perpetual fault of one merit compensation unit or more would bring rank reduction and a one-year bar; perpetual fault of less than one unit would still bar for one year.

sentences.zh: 章宗大定二十九年，罷年遷之法，更定制，比永課增及一酬遷一官，兩酬遷兩官，如虧課則削亦如之，各兩官止。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhangzong, twenty-ninth year of Dading, abolished the method of annual advancement, re-fixed the standing rule: compared to the perpetual quota, increase reaching one compensation unit advances one rank, two units two ranks; if fault against the quota, demotion likewise—each capped at two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 29 (1189) Emperor Zhangzong abolished annual advancement and fixed a new rule: one merit compensation unit above the perpetual quota meant one rank gained, two units two ranks; shortfalls brought proportional demotion, each capped at two ranks.

sentences.zh: 又罷使司小都監與使副一體論增虧者，及罷餘前升降不盡之數後任充折之制。

translations.literal: Also abolished treating assistant bureau directors of the commissary with deputy commissioners as a single unit for calculating surplus and fault, and abolished the system of applying unused prior promotion and demotion numbers as offset in the succeeding term.
translations.idiomatic: The rule treating assistant bureau directors and deputy commissioners as a single unit for surplus and fault calculations was abolished, as was carrying unused adjustments to the next term.

sentences.zh: 泰和元年，制犯選及虧永者，右職漢人至宣武將軍從五品、女直至廣威將軍正五品，方注縣令。

translations.literal: Taihe first year, regulated: those who violated selection rules and had perpetual fault—Han Chinese of the right-wing offices up to General of Manifest Martiality secondary fifth rank, Jurchen women up to General of Broad Martiality regular fifth rank—only then register as county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 1 (1201) a rule fixed that Han right-wing officials guilty of selection violations or perpetual fault, and Jurchen women, needed to reach secondary fifth or regular fifth rank respectively before appointment as county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 又吏格，曾犯選及虧永者，女直至武義從六，漢人及諸色人至武略從六，皆注諸司，亦兩除一差，至明威方注丞簿。

translations.literal: Also in the personnel regulations: those who once violated selection or had perpetual fault—Jurchen women up to Martial Righteousness secondary sixth, Han Chinese and all categories up to Martial Strategy secondary sixth—all register in various bureaus, also two dismissals one assignment; only at Mingwei register as assistant magistrate or registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel regulations further provided that such offenders—Jurchen women to secondary sixth, Hans and others to secondary sixth—were posted to bureaus through two dismissals per assignment, reaching assistant magistrate or registrar only at Mingwei rank.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，制曾虧永、犯選者，遷至宣武，注諸司，至懷遠從四下，方注丞簿，至安遠從四上，注下令。

translations.literal: Zhenyou third year, regulated: those who once had perpetual fault or violated selection—advance to Manifest Martiality, register in bureaus; reach Boundless Fidelity secondary fourth lower, then register as assistant magistrate or registrar; reach Settled Distance secondary fourth upper, then register as lower county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyou 3 (1215), offenders had to reach Manifest Martiality for bureau posts, Boundless Fidelity for registrar or assistant magistrate, and Settled Distance for lower county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 正大元年，制曾犯選、曾虧永者，至廣威與諸司、兩除一差，至安遠注丞簿，三任，其至鎮國從三品下，方注下令。

translations.literal: Zhengda first year, regulated: those who once violated selection or once had perpetual fault—reach Broad Martiality for bureaus with two dismissals one assignment; reach Settled Distance for assistant magistrate or registrar, three terms; reach Pacifying the State secondary third lower, then register as lower county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengda 1 (1224), such officials needed Broad Martiality for bureau posts with two dismissals per assignment, Settled Distance for registrar or assistant magistrate after three terms, and Pacifying the State for lower county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 群牧官三周歲為滿，所牧之畜以十為率，駝增二頭，馬增二匹，牛亦如之，羊增四口，而大馬百死十五匹者，及能征前官所虧，三分為率，能盡征及征二分半以上，為上等，升一品級。

translations.literal: Pasture officials: three full years constitute completion; livestock herded count by tens—camels increase two head, horses two horses, cattle likewise, sheep four mouths; and among great horses death of fifteen per hundred—and able to recover what the prior official faulted, by a rate of three parts, able to recover all or two and a half parts or more—is upper grade, advance one rank grade.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture officials served three-year terms; herd increases were measured in tens—two camels, two horses, two head of cattle, four sheep—and among horses no more than fifteen deaths per hundred; recovering all or at least five-sixths of a predecessor's shortfall rated upper grade and merited one rank.

sentences.zh: 駝增一，馬牛增二，羊增三，大馬百死二十五，征前官所虧二分以上，為中等，約量升除。

translations.literal: Camels increase one, horses and cattle increase two, sheep three; great horses death twenty-five per hundred; recover prior official's fault two parts or more—middle grade, approximately promote or dismiss.
translations.idiomatic: One camel, two horses or cattle, three sheep, twenty-five horse deaths per hundred, and recovery of two-thirds or more of prior shortfalls rated middle grade and brought appropriate promotion.

sentences.zh: 駝不增，馬牛增一，羊增二，大馬百死三十，征虧一分以上，為下等，依本等除。

translations.literal: Camels not increasing, horses and cattle increase one, sheep two; great horses death thirty per hundred; recover fault one part or more—lower grade, dismiss according to original grade.
translations.idiomatic: No camel increase, one horse or cattle, two sheep, thirty deaths per hundred, and recovery of one-third or more of shortfalls rated lower grade and brought standard appointment.

sentences.zh: 餘畜皆依元數，而大馬百死四十，征虧不及一分者，降一等。

translations.literal: Remaining livestock all according to original numbers; but great horses death forty per hundred, recover fault not reaching one part—demote one grade.
translations.idiomatic: If other livestock met original counts but horse deaths reached forty per hundred and shortfall recovery fell below one-third, the official was demoted one grade.

sentences.zh: 此明昌四年制也。

translations.literal: This was the regulation of the fourth year of Mingchang.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Mingchang 4 (1193) regulation.

sentences.zh: 五年，制馬牛羊虧元數十之一，騬馬百死四十，征虧不及一分者，降一等，決四十。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, it was regulated that for horses, cattle, and sheep short of the original count by one in ten, for gelded horses forty deaths per hundred, those recovering shortfalls of less than one in ten were demoted one grade and sentenced to forty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year a rule fixed that if horses, cattle, and sheep fell one-tenth below the original count, or gelded horses suffered forty deaths per hundred, and recovery of shortfalls fell short of one-tenth, the official was demoted one grade and sentenced to forty strokes.

sentences.zh: 若駝馬牛羊虧元數一分、馬百死四十，征虧不得者，杖八十，降同前。

translations.literal: If camels, horses, cattle, and sheep were short of the original count by one in ten, horses forty deaths per hundred, and shortfalls could not be recovered, eighty strokes and demotion as before.
translations.idiomatic: If camels, horses, cattle, and sheep fell one-tenth below the original count, horses suffered forty deaths per hundred, and shortfalls could not be recovered, the penalty was eighty strokes and demotion as before.
